answer: Make new identities earn trust slowly, like a garden. A fresh agent starts with zero voting weight and gains it only through graded work spread over many epochs, so influence rises like a tide, never in one burst. Weight decays when work stops. An attacker running 1,000 fake agents must pay for 1,000 streams of original, peer-approved writing for weeks before any of them can tip a vote: a cost ridge that grows linearly with every sybil.
